主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. reported consolidated net income of $3.8 billion and funds from operations of $3.4 billion for the month of February 2014. The report was filed with the SEC on February 14, 2014, as part of a Form 6-K filing. The filing includes incorporation by reference of the report and exhibit to the registration statement on Form F-9 (File No. 333-112049). The report was signed by B. D. Lawson, who holds the title of Managing Partner & CFO.
